---
title: "smrna-nextflow report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  outdir: "results"
  run_biotype: false
  run_isomir: false
  run_functional: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(knitr)
})

d  <- file.path(params$outdir, "deliverables")
ri <- file.path(params$outdir, "run_info")

check <- function(...) {
  for (p in c(...)) {
    if (!file.exists(p)) stop(sprintf("Report input missing: %s\nPhase 1 is incomplete for this outdir.", p))
  }
}

figure <- function(p, width = 7) {
  if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p)
  else cat(sprintf("_missing: %s_\n", p))
}
```

# Summary

```{r, results='asis'}
check(file.path(d, "qc", "qc_table.tsv"),
      file.path(d, "qc", "qc_flags.tsv"),
      file.path(d, "qc", "composition_by_sample.tsv"),
      file.path(d, "de", "de_summary.tsv"),
      file.path(d, "de", "concordance.tsv"))

qc        <- fread(file.path(d, "qc", "qc_table.tsv"))
flags     <- fread(file.path(d, "qc", "qc_flags.tsv"))
de_summary <- fread(file.path(d, "de", "de_summary.tsv"))
main_sum  <- de_summary[run == "main"]

cat(sprintf("- Samples: **%d** across %d norm_group(s).\n",
            nrow(qc), uniqueN(qc$norm_group)))
cat(sprintf("- Contrasts tested (main): **%d**.\n", nrow(main_sum)))
cat(sprintf("- Significant miRNAs in main: **%d** up / **%d** down; **%d** with |log2FC| >= lfc_flag.\n",
            sum(main_sum$n_up), sum(main_sum$n_down), sum(main_sum$n_sig_lfc1)))
cat(sprintf("- Flagged samples (not excluded): **%d**.\n",
            if (nrow(flags) > 0) uniqueN(flags$sample_id) else 0))
```

# PCA and sample distances


# Differential expression

```{r}
kable(de_summary)
```

```{r}
kable(fread(file.path(d, "de", "concordance.tsv")), digits = 3)
```

```{r, results='asis'}
de_dirs <- list.dirs(file.path(d, "de"), recursive = FALSE)
for (cdir in de_dirs) {
  sig <- file.path(cdir, "de_significant.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(sig)) next
  s <- fread(sig)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", basename(cdir)))
  if (nrow(s) > 0) {
    print(kable(head(s[order(padj)][, .(mirna, log2FC_shrunk, padj, direction, sig_lfc1)], 20), digits = 3))
  } else {
    cat("_No significant miRNAs._\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
for (cdir in list.dirs(file.path(d, "de"), recursive = FALSE)) {
  v <- file.path(cdir, "plots", "volcano.png")
  if (file.exists(v)) figure(v, width = 6)
}
```

# isomiRs

```{r, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(params$run_isomir) && dir.exists(file.path(d, "isomir"))) {
  f <- file.path(d, "isomir", "isomir_profile_by_sample.tsv")
  if (file.exists(f)) kable(head(fread(f), 30), digits = 3) else cat("_isomiR tables not found._\n")
} else {

}
```

# Functional enrichment

```{r, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(params$run_functional) && dir.exists(file.path(d, "functional"))) {
  cats <- list.dirs(file.path(d, "functional"), recursive = FALSE)
  for (cdir in cats) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", basename(cdir)))
    for (f in c("ora_up.tsv", "ora_down.tsv")) {
      p <- file.path(cdir, f)
      if (file.exists(p)) { cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n", f)); print(kable(head(fread(p), 20), digits = 3)) }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("_Phase 3 (functional) not enabled or not available._\n")
}
```

# Read probes

```{r, results='asis'}
pf <- file.path(d, "probes")
if (dir.exists(pf)) {
  s <- file.path(pf, "probe_summary.tsv")
  if (file.exists(s)) {
    cat("**probe_summary.tsv**\n\n")
    print(kable(head(fread(s), 40), digits = 3))
  }
  u <- file.path(pf, "top_unknown_by_sample.tsv")
  if (file.exists(u)) {
    cat("\n\n**top_unknown_by_sample.tsv** (most abundant 'unknown' reads per sample)\n\n")
    print(kable(head(fread(u), 20), digits = 3))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No probe file provided (read probes disabled)._\n")
}
```

# Methods

- Counts are split 1/k across their miRNAs for multi-assigned reads, then rounded.
- Differential expression: DESeq2 per `norm_group`. Main model `~ batch + condition` when the group has at least 2 batch levels, else `~ condition`; sensitivities: `sens_condition`, `sens_mature`, `sens_no_flagged`.
- log2FC = treatment / reference; positive means more abundant in `treatment`.
- `sig_lfc1` flags `padj < alpha` and `|log2FC_shrunk| >= lfc_flag`.
- Expression filter: CPM >= `min_cpm` in at least the smallest level of the group and total count >= `min_total_count`.

# Limitations

- Composition percentages are relative to the small RNA content of each sample; they are compositional, not absolute.
- DE is relative to the total miRNA fraction, not absolute abundance.
- Only fragments derived from snoRNA are captured by this library.
- Small n; interpret per-contrast results with care.
